pr.title: fix(vercel): Fix ISR path rewrite to prevent 404
pr.body: Fix a bug which prevented pages from being served by ISR by the vercel adapter. PR #15959 introduced a bug which made any route served by ISR result in a 404, because ISR functions are only given the original path via a query param. No additional tests added; manual e2e on a test vercel project. No docs needed.

intent.summary: Restore ISR page serving on the Vercel adapter. #15959 made the serverless entrypoint honor the x-astro-path header only with a valid middleware secret, so ISR routes (which only receive the original path via the x_astro_path query param) 404ed. The diff makes entrypoint.ts also rewrite url.pathname from x_astro_path when the request carries x-vercel-isr: 1 and no valid secret.
